name: align-codex-edit-after-patch
description: A Codex patch (p1) rewrites `pub fn b`, with a unique context so it is placed with certainty. Afterwards something uncaptured rewrites that same line again and appends one more function. Rule 8 / rule 5: `a` and `c` occur once and unchanged on both sides and stay base; the rewritten `b` line (p1 wrote the earlier version) and the appended `d` exist only because of the uncaptured change: Unknown(noCapture). The line is not p1's any more, since the text in the file is not the text p1 wrote.
